newsitem.title: FRANCE: Air France trucks trapped by road blocks.
newsitem.headline: Air France trucks trapped by road blocks.

text.p: Air France said its trucking services between Paris and Nice had been severely disrupted as a result of road blocks set up by striking lorry drivers.
"Two of our trucks were due to arrive in Nice this morning but the latest reports indicate they are stuck in traffic near Aix-en-Provence," a Nice-based Air France Cargo official told Reuters.
The trucks were scheduled to make return trips to Paris at midday today but these had had to be cancelled, the official said.
Meanwhile, Air France Cargo's Paris-Lyon trucking services were operating more or less normally, an airline official said.

"While there have been delays on scheduled departures and arrivals, trucks are getting through which is more than can be said for traffic in other regions if France, notably Toulouse and Bordeaux" an airline official said.
Each day Air France operates two to four trucking services in each direction between Paris and Lyon. -- Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
